messages.subject: Re: MaxQtoMSstatsFormat: what is annotation.txt?
messages.body_plain:
Thanks for your reply, Meena.

We want to read a TMT MaxQuant analysis [1]. As  described in the manual, we generated an annotation.csv file [2].
It is a very simple setup: eight fractions of a 10-plex TMT experiment. No technical or biological replicates.

We run into the following error message [3]. Is an additional run column necessary?
Thanks for your support.

Lars

Hi Meena,

I tried to import a complete MQ LFQ analysis with the standard MSstats 3.12.3 package. This Dropbox [4] includes a complete MaxQuant txt folder, our annotation.txt file and the R script.
No crashes, but the resulting 'raw' dataframe is empty.

Our aim is to import complete MaxQuant analyses (LFQ, labelled or TMT) into R using your API. I think that will be faster than us starting to write a MaxQuant parser from scratch.
Best regards

Lars

[4] https://www.dropbox.com/sh/i3o658g8exz1czr/AACHjnkGsBtTW7sleB9or6zVa?dl=1

messages.subject: Re: MaxQtoMSstatsFormat: what is annotation.txt?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Lars,

It seems that there is the issue in annotation file.
IsotopeLabelType has only 'none'. It should be 'L' or 'H', or 'light' or 'heavy'. After I fixed IsotopeLabelType column, I can have 'raw' data with around 330k rows.

Also, Just in case if you have fraction, please add 'Fraction' column in annotation.

For MSstatsTMT, we have been fixing all reported issue last few days. I hope that it will be ready by tonight.
annotation for MSstatsTMT, please check example or help file for example dataset in MSstatsTMT, like annotation.mq <http://annotation.mq>, annotation.pd, and so on.

- Meena

messages.body_plain:
H Meena,

I included the changes and updated the Dropbox [4]. The dataframe now has about 340k rows. But only a single Intensity column. This is an LFQ analysis with 29 reported intensities (see for example 'Intensity 181` to `Intensity 209` in proteinGroups.txt).

We are working on a small MQ2mzTab script [5] which transfers the complete MaxQuant results to the PSM, PEP and PRT sections of mzTab [6]. Instead of writing a MaxQuant parser from scratch, we would like to make use of yours.
Best regards

Lars

[5] https://github.com/ProteomicsScripts/ProteomicsScripts/tree/master/MQ2mzTab

[6] J. A. Vizcaíno et al. (2014) The twenty minute guide to mzTab. Retrieved May 3, 2015, from http://www.psidev.info/mztab http://bit.ly/2g3qlus

Hope that it can be the answer.

- Meena

Thanks, Meena. That makes sense and is very neat! See also [5]. I updated again the Dropbox [4] and our repository. I now widen the dataframe with tidyr [6].

Yet, I have one further question. Some sequences in the raw dataframe [7] report PrecursorCharge = NA although evidence.txt reports charges for every single sequence.  See for example WDEELAAFAK and (ac)SLYPSLEDLK in the Dropbox example [4].

Why is that?
Best regards

Lars

[5] H. Wickham, Tidy Data https://www.jstatsoft.org/index.php/jss/article/view/v059i10/v59i10.pdf

[6] https://github.com/ProteomicsScripts/ProteomicsScripts/blob/master/MSstats/ParseMaxQuant_labelfree.R#L31

[7] https://github.com/ProteomicsScripts/ProteomicsScripts/blob/master/MSstats/ParseMaxQuant_labelfree.R#L25
